meta.title: JANUS Governance Challenge Harness v0.3.3 — Independent Zero-Open-Finding Adversarial Regression — raw results
meta.tester: Claude (independent regression, Claude in Chrome + headless Chromium replica)

environments.E1: Live GitHub Pages deployment in the user's Chrome; in-page oracle; browser download suppressed (Blob captured) except where noted
environments.E2: Headless Chromium 1194 (Playwright 1.56); every newsomek.github.io request answered from repository HEAD bytes; raw.githubusercontent answered from git objects; api.github.com emulated as {sha: eb65796, parents:[7322fea]} unless overridden; real download events

meta.oracle: Expected contracts taken from reviewed baseline dc621ff:app.js (scenario block byte-identical to v0.3.2 ef0f675 and v0.3.3 HEAD); contract/core/snapshot hashes recomputed independently

release.manifest_files_live_match: 17/17 (hashed in the browser from the live site)

tests/v0.3.3-hardening-regression.mjs.nature: 11 static source-text / regex checks; no behavioural execution

tests/v0.3.2-regression.mjs (named by V0.error: TypeError: scenarioSummary.replaceChildren is not a function (app.js:261) — mock DOM predates v0.3.3

mutation_testing.method: revert one v0.3.3 fix in a copy of app.js, run both suites

notes: 4 rows re-run: 1 (evidence-change × INSUFFICIENT_SPECIFICATION) because the first-pass wait helper returned while Run was still in flight so the Replay/Export clicks hit correctly-disabled buttons; 3 (mid-execution-revocation × ESCALATE/ROLLBACK/INSUF) because the oracle regex accepted only HTTP 403 for quota exhaustion while GitHub returned HTTP 429. All four passed on re-run; no application defect.
GitHub main corroboration: MATCH until quota exhausted, then UNAVAILABLE (HTTP 403 / 429), correctly classified, with no effect on PASS or on evidence cores.
All 36 live evidence-core hashes equal the E2 replica hashes.
